description: Temporary change of use of the park for a walking trail and the display of animatronic beasts of varying shapes and sizes distributed around the grounds between 21st March 2022 and 25th April 2022. Erection of associated temporary structures
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The event is permitted between 21st March 2022 and the 25th April 2022
inclusive of site construction and demolition.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (DS616-P-01A, DS616-P-02A, DS616-P-03A, DS616-P-04A, DS616-P-05A, Planning and
Heritage Statement, Event Noise Impact Assessment, Ecological Survey and
Environmental Statement, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Tree Survey, Tree Impact
Plan, Transport Assessment prepared, Draft Construction Traffic Management Plan,
Design and Access Statement, Event Management Plan, Crowd Management Plan,
Letter of Support by Gunnersbury Estate (2026) CIC; Fire Statement & Flood Risk
Assessment Received 06/01/2022; Construction Traffic Management Plan, Travel Plan
Statement, Technical Note - Impacts on TFL Services, Technical Note - Parking
Management Plan & Technical Note - Cycle Parking (2111-020/TN/03) Received
25/02/2022; Delivery & Servicing Management Plan Received 21/03/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The Delivery and Servicing Management Plan shall be carried out in
accordance with the hereby approved Delivery & Servicing Management
Plan, any alterations or amendments must be agreed in writing with the
Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - DS616-P-01A, DS616-P-02A, DS616-P-03A, DS616-P-04A, DS616-P-05A, Planning and
Heritage Statement, Event Noise Impact Assessment, Ecological Survey and
Environmental Statement, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Tree Survey, Tree Impact
Plan, Transport Assessment prepared, Draft Construction Traffic Management Plan,
Design and Access Statement, Event Management Plan, Crowd Management Plan,
Letter of Support by Gunnersbury Estate (2026) CIC; Fire Statement & Flood Risk
Assessment Received 06/01/2022; Construction Traffic Management Plan, Travel Plan
Statement, Technical Note - Impacts on TFL Services, Technical Note - Parking
Management Plan & Technical Note - Cycle Parking (2111-020/TN/03) Received
25/02/2022; Delivery & Servicing Management Plan Received 21/03/2022

Condition : 5 - The cycle storage units referred to in the approved plans shall be installed
and made available for use prior to the first event and the spaces shall be
available throughout the duration of the event.

Condition : 6 - The floodlighting hereby approved shall only be operational 0800-1900
and turned off at all other times, except for that required for security and
safety purposes. Floodlighting will take into consideration the location of
and proximity to local residential premises.

Condition : 7 - The uses and structures hereby approved shall only be operational 10:00-
19:00 for the duration of the permission, with last entry of 17:00.

Condition : 8 - The applicant shall keep a photo record and site conditions report for the
duration of the time limit specified in Condition 1, and on conclusion of the
events hereby approved shall, within two months, complete the necessary
remediation to return the site to its pre-event state as a minimum (save for
any wear and tear as identified in the lease agreement).

Condition : 9 - The event shall be carried out in accordance with the hereby approved
Event Noise Impact Assessment, any alterations or amendments must be
agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 10 - The event shall be carried out in accordance with the events management
documents provided pertaining to crowd management and the event
management safety plan.

Condition : 11 - The Construction Traffic Management Plan details shall be in line with the
hereby approved Construction Traffic Management Plan. Any amendments
or alterations shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local
Planning Authority.

Condition : 12 - Before the development hereby permitted commences at the site, the
protection measures outlined in the hereby approved Arboricultural Impact
Assessment including root protection areas, tree protection fences, ground
protection areas and other general measures shall be undertaken at the
site and shall be retained for the entire period of the duration of the event
and any work, in connection with the development hereby permitted, within
the fence or other means of enclosure surrounding the trees, no activities
associated with building operations shall take place.
